items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 6 at 11:31AM AKDT until May 7 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Aniak, as well as from Crooked Creek to below Napaimute.

* WHEN...Through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Ice jams may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, sloughs, and other low-lying flood prone locations. Water
may impound behind a jam which may cause flooding several miles
upstream.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 6 at 10:18AM AKDT until May 7 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
TANANA RIVER BREAKUP CONTINUES TO PROGRESS DOWNSTREAM OF NENANA.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues to be possible.

* WHERE...Along the Yukon River, downstream of Dawson

* WHEN...Through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The Yukon River broke up locally at Eagle on Tuesday morning
and Dawson on Tuesday afternoon.  Currently the breakup front
is located somewhere downstream of the Tatonduk River.

items.description:
